remarks: Welcome home! This beautiful townhouse in the heart of downtown Stamford offers the perfect blend of modern comfort & urban convenience. The open-concept living room boasts a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings. The neutral color palette hard wood, floors, recessed lighting and & large windows create a warm & inviting atmosphere. Updated kitchen bright quartz counters, ss appliances, and a stylish tile backsplash, making it a chef's delight. The adjacent dining area, illuminated by a contemporary chandelier, offers a cozy space for family meals and entertaining guests. The elegant dining area seamlessly connects to the living room and kitchen, offering a bright and airy space. Large windows and a glass sliding door lead to a private balcony, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or an evening cocktail. The primary bedroom is a serene retreat, complete with ample natural light, a ceiling fan, and a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom. The other bedroom is equally spacious and well-lit, providing plenty of room for rest and relaxation. The bathrooms are updated with stylish fixtures, modern vanities, and clean, bright finishes. The master bathroom includes a walk-in shower and ample storage space. Prime Location: Situated in the vibrant downtown Stamford area, this townhouse offers easy access to shopping, dining, entertainment, and public transportation, making it a convenient choice for those who want to experience the best of city living.
